# .github/workflows/android.yml
- Lines: 171 | Kind: PR-gating workflow (APK build) | Verdict: KEEP, SIMPLIFY (delete dispatch-only verify, vendor test and duplicate setup)
- Covers: produces `Android foundation result`: builds the flag-off developer APKs for both variants (`android:build --allow-unpackaged-runtime --skip-instrumentation`), qualifies the Calendar bridge Java compile (`calendar-bridge.py`), audits the web bundle and APK manifest, stages the AOSP overlay. Duplicates: `browser.yml` verify (dispatch-only steps :31-34, :63-82), `resident-android.yml:272` (upstream vendor test). Callers/importers: triggers push main+develop, PR, dispatch; uses `changes.yml`; text read by `test/ci-required-checks.test.mjs:53,98`, `test/ci-emulator-evidence.test.mjs`, `test/app-update-candidate.test.mjs`; named in `scripts/ci/affected.ts:35`, `scripts/ci/calendar-bridge.init.gradle`, `scripts/generate-licenses.ts`, `scripts/qualify-head.ts`, `scripts/owner/emulator-campaign-check.ts`, `specs/quint/services/manifest.json`, `specs/quint/refinement/services/app-update-candidate.mjs` (comment/mentions; check before renaming).
- Health: build ~10 min; this is the one lane the research did not flag as failing.

## Proposed end state
- One `build` job: composite android-toolchain setup → `npm ci` → json jar → `prepare-local-agent --source-only` → calendar-bridge source frame → `android:build` → calendar-bridge → `verify-apks`/bundle audit → `aosp:stage` → uploads.
- No dispatch-only verify, no vendor test, one `setup-bun` (or none: confirm `android:build` does not need Bun without the SDK step).
- Triggers: PR (path-selected) + dispatch; `result` job stays as the stable check until the owner changes the ruleset.
